# OpenAnyDoc

> OpenAnyDoc is a free, open-source viewer, editor and converter for CSV, Excel (XLSX, XLS, XLSM, ODS), JSON and TXT files, a viewer for Word documents (DOCX), PowerPoint slides (PPTX), PDF files and pictures, and a set of PDF and image tools, that runs in your browser: files are never uploaded. No account, no cookies, no analytics. English and Arabic. MIT licence.

How it keeps files private: the site's Content-Security-Policy is `default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'`, so the browser refuses any request to another origin, and an automated test suite fails the build if any page makes a network request or writes browser storage beyond the theme choice. Anyone can confirm this in the browser's Network tab while opening a file.

What it handles: CSV, TSV and tab files with automatic delimiter and encoding detection (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1256) and 100,000+ rows; Excel workbooks with every sheet, formulas that recalculate, number formats, merged cells and cell styles for .xlsx; JSON up to 10 MB with tree, table and text views, a validator that reports the line and column of an error, repair, format and minify; plain text with encoding and line-ending choices; Word .docx, .dotx and .docm documents (macros are never run) and OpenDocument .odt text shown as pages with fonts, tables, images, lists, headers and footers, right-to-left Arabic, zoom, and print or save as PDF, plus a navigation pane from the headings, search with highlighted matches, word and page counts with the author and dates, comments and tracked changes in the margin (read only), a reading mode with larger text and dark pages, read aloud with the voices installed on the device, and export as plain text, Markdown or HTML or all pictures as a ZIP (to change a document, use the Word tools below; old .doc files are not supported); PowerPoint .pptx, .ppsx, .potx and .pptm presentations in beta (macros are never run), one slide at a time with text, images, tables and shapes, thumbnails, a grid of all slides, arrow keys and full screen, plus speaker notes, a presenter view with the current and next slide, notes and a timer while the audience sees the slide in a second window, search across slides and notes, read aloud with the voices installed on the device, an outline export as Markdown or text, slides saved as PNG pictures, and print or save as PDF (animations are not played; to change a presentation, use the PowerPoint tools below; old .ppt files are not supported). Microsoft's standalone PowerPoint Viewer has been retired; this page opens .pptx files without installing anything. Files download back in their own format, or convert between formats: Excel to CSV or JSON, CSV to Excel or JSON, and JSON to CSV with nested objects flattened into dot-notation columns. The JSON viewer also opens JSON Lines, JSON5, YAML and GeoJSON, shows a graph of the document, compares two documents, validates against a JSON Schema (and writes one), runs JSONPath queries live, converts to YAML, XML or TypeScript interfaces, and can open a file from an https address you type (your browser fetches it directly). The Excel viewer also shows frozen panes, hidden rows, columns and sheets, notes and links, has column filters and a column profile, Show formulas and a list of every formula, search across all sheets, compares two sheets or two workbooks, splits a workbook into one file per sheet, merges sheets from several workbooks, saves every sheet as CSV in one ZIP, prints or saves a sheet as PDF, and reports what a workbook holds (macros are detected and never run; workbooks encrypted with a password to open can't be opened, while sheet protection can be removed with Unprotect Excel). The CSV viewer also opens Parquet files (read only), has a filter row under the headers, a health check (mixed types, spaces, repeated rows), a quick bar, line or pie chart, SQL queries in the browser, and saves what you see as Excel, Markdown, HTML or SQL INSERT statements, or as a zip of smaller CSV files. Sensitive data in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files can be masked before sharing, on the Mask data page or with the Mask button in the CSV, Excel and JSON viewers. PDF tools: merge, split, remove or extract pages, organize (reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate, blank pages), rotate and number PDFs, turn JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG and HEIC pictures into a PDF, save PDF pages as JPG or PNG, get a PDF's text as .txt, save the pictures inside a PDF as a ZIP, add text boxes, highlights, drawings, shapes and pictures to a PDF, sign it with a drawn, typed or uploaded signature (a visual signature, not a certificate-based digital signature), fill in PDF forms (optionally flattened), add watermarks, headers and footers, compress, flatten, make grayscale, remove metadata, redact, compare, repair, OCR, translate, convert to and from Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and protect or unlock with a password (a PDF with a password to open needs Unlock PDF first, with the password). The PDF viewer shows PDFs as continuous pages with thumbnails, zoom, fit to width, rotation, go to page, search with highlights, selectable text (Arabic included), and a password prompt that stays on the device (view only; scanned PDFs have no text to search until OCR PDF adds a text layer). Image tools work on many pictures at once (one ZIP): compress JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF with high-quality encoders and a before/after slider, resize by pixels, percent or ready sizes (Instagram, WhatsApp, passport photos at 300 dpi), crop (fixed ratios or a transparent circle), rotate and flip, add a text or logo watermark, remove GPS, camera and date metadata (JPG, PNG and WebP pixels unchanged), edit a photo (brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, filters, text, with undo), convert between JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF from HEIC, TIFF, SVG, GIF and BMP too, and make memes with Arabic captions. The image viewer opens JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, HEIC, TIFF and SVG with zoom and the camera, date and GPS details. iPhone HEIC photos are decoded in the browser too.

## Answers

- Is my file uploaded? No. The browser reads and changes it on the device. The page's Content-Security-Policy lets it contact only its own site, plus one exception: the JSON page's "Open from a URL" fetches the https address the visitor types. How to verify: https://www.openanydoc.com/en/check-file-upload
- Which formats? .csv, .tsv, .tab, .parquet, .xlsx, .xls, .xlsm, .ods, .json, .jsonl, .txt, .docx, .dotx, .docm, .odt, .pptx, .ppsx, .potx, .pptm and .pdf. Word and PowerPoint files can be viewed, converted (to PDF, JPG, Markdown), merged, split, watermarked, compared and cleaned of metadata. Not old .doc or .ppt files. JPG to PDF also takes .jpg, .png, .webp, .tif and .svg pictures.
- Word to PDF? Yes: Word to PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-to-pdf) saves .docx, .dotx, .docm and .odt documents as PDF pages at 200 dpi with searchable text, Arabic included, in the browser. Old .doc files: save them as .docx first.
- Compress a PDF? Yes: Compress PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compress-pdf) re-saves the pictures inside as JPEG at quality 85, 70 or 50 (High quality, Balanced, Smallest), recompresses the rest without loss and removes unused objects; it shows the size before and after, and if the copy isn't smaller you keep the original. Picture resolution is not lowered.
- How big a file? CSV has no fixed limit (a 120,000-row file opens in under a second; a warning above 50 MB). JSON up to 10 MB. Excel cell styles are read for files up to 8 MB.
- Arabic? The whole interface is in Arabic too (https://www.openanydoc.com/ar). CSV files in Windows-1256 are detected, and downloads add a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel shows Arabic correctly.
- Offline? Yes. After the first visit, each tool page and its viewer are kept by the browser (a service worker), so files open and edit with no network; AI tools work offline after their first use. It can be installed as an app (Chrome, Edge, Android; Add to Home Screen on iPhone and iPad), which opens files from the desktop and takes files shared on Android.
- Does it change my original file? No. Edits stay in the page's memory until you download a copy.
- Price? Free, with no account, plans or ads.
- Can I try it without a file? Yes. Every tool page has two "Try a sample file" buttons with small made-up files (Arabic text, a workbook with three sheets, a 150,000-row CSV, a short Word document, three slides), opened in the browser like any other file.
- Can I hide personal data before sharing a file or pasting it into an AI assistant? Yes. The Mask data tool finds names, emails, phone numbers, Saudi national ID and Iqama numbers, IBANs and card numbers in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files and replaces them with consistent tokens (EMAIL-000001), partial masks (****1234) or removes the field, in the browser. An optional private key file restores the tokens later. https://www.openanydoc.com/en/mask-data

- Can I edit a PDF? Yes: Edit PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/edit-pdf) adds text boxes, highlights, freehand drawing, shapes and pictures, with undo and redo. Text already in the PDF cannot be rewritten; cover it with a white rectangle and type over it.
- Can I sign a PDF? Yes: Sign PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/sign-pdf) places a drawn, typed or uploaded signature on one or many pages. It is a visual signature, not a certificate-based digital signature, and it does not prove who signed.
- Can I fill in a PDF form? Yes: Fill PDF form (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/fill-pdf) fills text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and drop-downs; "Flatten on save" makes the answers part of the page. XFA forms are not supported.
- Merge or split a PDF without uploading it? Yes: Merge PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-pdf) and Split PDF (https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-pdf) copy pages unchanged in the browser, with no size cap other than the device's memory.
- Password-protected PDFs? The PDF viewer opens them after you type the password (it stays on the device). The other PDF tools need the password removed first: Unlock PDF does that in the browser when you know the password (it does not guess passwords). https://www.openanydoc.com/en/unlock-pdf
- Scanned PDFs? They open and can be merged, split, rotated, signed and watermarked, but they hold pictures, not text. OCR PDF reads their words (English or Arabic) on the device and adds a searchable text layer; then PDF to text, PDF to Word and the other converters can use them. https://www.openanydoc.com/en/ocr-pdf
- Arabic PDFs? Text is searched, selected and extracted in reading order; page numbers, headers and watermarks can use Arabic words and Arabic-Indic digits.

## Pricing

- Free. No plans, no ads, no account. The source is public under the MIT licence and the built site can be hosted on an internal network.

## Tools

- [CSV viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-viewer): open, search, sort, filter, edit and download CSV and TSV files
- [Excel viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-viewer): XLSX, XLS, XLSM and ODS workbooks with formulas and styles
- [JSON viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-viewer): tree, table and text views
- [JSON formatter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-formatter): pretty print with 1 to 8 spaces or tabs, minify, sort keys
- [JSON validator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-validator): errors with line and column, repair of common mistakes
- [TXT viewer and editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/txt-viewer): line numbers, find and replace, encodings and line endings
- [Word viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-viewer): DOCX, DOTX, DOCM and ODT documents as pages with fonts, tables, images, headers and footers; Arabic right to left; navigation, search, comments and tracked changes, reading mode, read aloud; zoom, print, save as PDF, export as text, Markdown or HTML
- [Word to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-to-jpg), [Excel to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-jpg) and [PowerPoint to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pptx-to-jpg): each page or slide as a JPG picture, several in a ZIP
- [Markdown to Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/markdown-to-word), [HTML to Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/html-to-word) and [Text to Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/text-to-word): an editable .docx with real headings, lists, tables and links
- [Images to PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/images-to-pptx): one picture per slide, 16:9 or 4:3, as an editable .pptx
- [Merge Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-word) (beta) and [Split Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-word) (at headings or page breaks); [Compare Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compare-word): two versions word by word, with a Word report of the changes
- [Word counter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-counter): words (Arabic counted by its own rules), characters, sentences, pages, reading and speaking time
- [Find and replace in Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-find-replace), [Remove comments and tracked changes](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-word-comments), [Watermark Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/watermark-word), [Extract images from Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/extract-word-images)
- [Mail merge](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-mail-merge): a .docx template with {{Column}} fields and a CSV or Excel file give one document per row, in a ZIP
- [Merge Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-excel), [Split Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-excel) (per sheet, every N rows or by a column's value), [Compare Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compare-excel), [Excel to Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-word)
- [Unprotect Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/unprotect-excel): removes sheet and workbook protection from files you own (no password guessing; files encrypted to open are not opened); [Repair Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/repair-excel): values, formulas and merged cells rewritten into a clean workbook
- [Merge PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-pptx) (beta), [Split PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-pptx), [Extract PowerPoint media](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/extract-pptx-media), [Search PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/search-pptx), [Watermark PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/watermark-pptx), [Remove macros (.pptm to .pptx)](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pptm-to-pptx)
- Metadata for [Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-metadata), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-metadata) and [PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pptx-metadata): author, company and dates shown, then removed in a copy
- [PowerPoint viewer (beta)](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/powerpoint-viewer): PPTX, PPSX, POTX and PPTM slides with text, images, tables and shapes; thumbnails, grid, speaker notes, presenter view, search, read aloud; outline export, PNG pictures, print and save as PDF
- [PDF viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-viewer): PDFs as continuous pages with thumbnails, zoom, rotation, go to page, search with highlights, selectable Arabic text, and a local password prompt
- [Large CSV viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/large-csv-viewer): files beyond Excel's row limit
- [TSV viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/tsv-viewer)
- [XLS viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/xls-viewer): legacy Excel 97-2003 files
- [Excel to CSV converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-csv): the first sheet opens as a UTF-8 CSV (with BOM for Arabic text) in the CSV viewer
- [CSV to Excel converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-excel): opens as .xlsx in the Excel viewer, with a bold header row and columns sized to fit
- [Excel to JSON converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-json): opens in the JSON viewer as an array of objects keyed by the header row, numbers kept as numbers
- [CSV to JSON converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-json): opens in the JSON viewer as an array of objects keyed by the header row
- [JSON to CSV converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-csv): opens in the CSV viewer, nested objects flattened into dot-notation columns
- [JSON escape, unescape and stringify](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-escape): turns a JSON document into one escaped string (quotes, backslashes, line breaks), unescapes a string from a log or an API response back into readable JSON, or copies the document as one quoted line for source code (the old /json-escape-unescape address redirects here)
- [JSON minifier](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-minify): one click to one line, with the bytes saved shown; Format puts the indentation back
- [Sort JSON keys](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-sort): object keys A–Z or Z–A on every level, natural number order, arrays keep their order
- [JSON tree viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-tree-viewer): collapsible tree opened two levels deep, search, copy a node's path
- [JSON graph](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-graph): the document as connected boxes (up to 1,500), export as PNG or SVG
- [Compare JSON](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-compare): differences by key and path against a second document, key order ignored by default
- [JSON Schema generator and validator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-schema): writes a draft 2020-12 schema from a document, or validates against a pasted schema
- [JSONPath tester](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/jsonpath): JSONPath queries with live results marked in the tree
- [JSON to YAML](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-yaml) and [YAML to JSON](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/yaml-to-json): comments are not kept
- [JSON to XML](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-xml) and [XML to JSON](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/xml-to-json): XML read by the browser's own parser, attributes as "@name", text as "#text"
- JSON to code types, written in the browser: [TypeScript interfaces](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-typescript), [Python dataclasses](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-python), [Go structs](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-go), [Java classes](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-java), [C# classes](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-csharp)
- [XML viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/xml-viewer): edit XML beside a tree, check it is well-formed (error line shown), format or minify
- [YAML formatter and validator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/yaml-formatter): errors with line and column, format with 2 or 4 spaces, a tree of the data
- [Base64 encode / decode](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/base64-encode-decode): UTF-8 text or any file to Base64 and back, URL-safe option
- [URL encode / decode](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/url-encode-decode): a part of a URL or a whole URL, percent-encoded or decoded
- [JWT decoder](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/jwt-decoder): header and payload as JSON, exp/iat/nbf as dates with "expired" or "valid for"; the signature is never verified and the token never sent
- CSV and Excel to text, shown at once to copy or download: SQL INSERT ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-sql), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-sql)), XML ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-xml), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-xml)), YAML ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-yaml), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-yaml)), Markdown table ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-markdown), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-markdown)), HTML table ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-html), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-html)), LaTeX tabular ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-latex), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-latex)), fixed-width text ([CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-fixed-width), [Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-fixed-width)); an Excel sheet at a time, cells as Excel shows them
- To CSV, opened in the CSV viewer: [XML to CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/xml-to-csv) (the first list of repeated elements), [YAML to CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/yaml-to-csv), [HTML table to CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/html-table-to-csv) (the largest table, spans repeated), [SQL to CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/sql-to-csv) (CREATE TABLE and INSERT run in the browser; MySQL and pg_dump --inserts dumps tidied first)
- [CSV validator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-validator): delimiter, encoding, BOM, line endings, rows and columns, every unclosed or undoubled quote with its row, uneven rows, mixed types, spaces and repeated rows
- [Split CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-csv) by rows or by size into a ZIP; [Merge CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-csv) (same column names, any order); [Compare CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compare-csv) by a key column (added, removed, changed rows)
- [SQL on CSV](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/sql-on-csv) (SQL run in the browser on a CSV or Excel file, results downloadable as CSV or Excel), [Pivot table](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pivot-table), [Chart maker](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/chart-maker) (bar, line, pie, PNG)
- [Remove duplicates](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-duplicates), [Transpose](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/transpose), [Change case](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/change-case) for CSV and Excel files; [Change CSV encoding](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/change-csv-encoding) (UTF-8 with BOM for Arabic in Excel, UTF-16, Windows-1256); [Change CSV delimiter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/change-csv-delimiter)
- [Test data generator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/test-data-generator): synthetic names (English and Arabic), example.com emails, fictional 555-01xx phones, dates and numbers, up to 100,000 rows, as CSV, Excel or JSON; no national IDs, IBANs or card numbers
- [AI-ready file tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/ai-tools): files made into text to paste into an AI chat, with the token count; no AI runs on these pages and nothing is sent to any AI service
- [PDF to Markdown](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-markdown) (headings, lists, simple tables; .md, .txt or .html), [Word to Markdown](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-to-markdown), [PowerPoint to Markdown](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pptx-to-markdown) (slide outline with speaker notes), [Excel to Markdown](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-markdown), [CSV to Markdown](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-markdown)
- [Token counter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/token-counter): tokens (the tokenizer GPT-4o models use; other models are estimates), words and characters of a file or pasted text; [JSON to TOON](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/json-to-toon): JSON to Token-Oriented Object Notation and back, with token counts before and after
- On-device AI (needs a recent desktop Chrome with its built-in AI; in other browsers the feature is hidden and there is no upload fallback): [AI summarizer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/ai-summarizer) (key points, short or long summary of a PDF, Word, PowerPoint, TXT or Markdown file), [Translate document](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/translate-document) (the text of a PDF, Word or text file into 39 languages including Arabic, not Urdu; .txt, .md or .docx), [Chat with PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/chat-with-pdf) (questions answered from the PDF's text). Arabic documents are translated to English on the device, worked on, and translated back. The PDF, Word and PowerPoint viewers have Summarise and Translate buttons in Chrome.
- OpenAnyDoc is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google; ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are named only as places people paste text.
- Every one of these pages: pasted text stays in the tab and is never sent anywhere; nothing is saved on the site, no share links, no history.
- [Mask sensitive data](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/mask-data): finds names, emails, phone numbers, national IDs, IBANs, card numbers, addresses and dates of birth in CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT files (any other column can be added) and replaces them with consistent tokens, partial masks or removal; an optional private key file restores the tokens. Also a Mask button in the CSV, Excel and JSON viewers
- [Merge PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/merge-pdf): combines several PDF files into one in the order you choose, pages copied as they are; the result can go straight to Add page numbers
- [Add page numbers to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/add-page-numbers): numbers every page at the top or bottom (left, centre or right), from any start number
- [Split PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/split-pdf): by page ranges, every N pages, or one file per page in a ZIP
- [Remove PDF pages](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-pdf-pages): click the pages to delete and download the rest
- [Extract PDF pages](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/extract-pdf-pages): click the pages to keep, as one PDF or one PDF per page
- [Organize PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/organize-pdf): drag pages into order, rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages, add another PDF, with undo
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/rotate-pdf): every page or the selected ones, left, right or upside down
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/jpg-to-pdf): JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, SVG and HEIC with page size, orientation and margin; one PDF or one per picture
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-jpg): every page or selected pages as JPG or PNG at 72, 150 or 300 dpi, in a ZIP
- [PDF to text](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-text): all the text as a .txt file, Arabic in reading order (scanned PDFs: run OCR PDF first)
- [Extract images from PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/extract-pdf-images): every embedded picture as PNG in a ZIP
- [Edit PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/edit-pdf): text boxes, highlights, freehand drawing, shapes and pictures, with undo; existing text can't be rewritten
- [Sign PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/sign-pdf): draw, type or upload a signature, place and resize it on one or many pages (a visual signature, not a certificate-based digital signature)
- [Fill PDF form](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/fill-pdf): text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and drop-downs, with Flatten on save
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/watermark-pdf): text or picture, opacity, rotation, nine positions or tiled, chosen pages
- [Header and footer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/header-footer-pdf): six text slots with page number, page count and date; Western or Arabic-Indic digits
- [Crop PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/crop-pdf): drag a box to cut margins from every page or chosen pages; what is outside is removed from the file (or only hidden, to keep vector pages), text stays selectable
- [Redact PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/redact-pdf): black out areas or every match of a word; the text under the boxes is removed from the file and the rest of the page stays selectable
- [Compare PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compare-pdf): two versions, added and removed lines page by page, and changed areas painted red
- [Repair PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/repair-pdf): rewrites a damaged PDF with a new cross-reference table, or rebuilds readable pages as pictures
- [Compress PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compress-pdf): pictures re-saved at a chosen quality, the rest compressed losslessly, unused objects removed; shows the size before and after (no promised percentage)
- [PDF to grayscale](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-grayscale) (beta): pages as grey pictures with the text still selectable and searchable
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/flatten-pdf) (beta): form fields and annotations made part of the page
- [Remove PDF metadata](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-pdf-metadata): title, author, app and dates shown, then removed with the XMP block
- [Scan to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/scan-to-pdf): phone photos of paper straightened from four corners, cleaned in black and white, saved as one PDF
- [PDF Forms](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-forms): add fillable text, long text, checkbox, drop-down, choice-button, date and signature fields to a PDF
- [Protect PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/protect-pdf): AES-256 password set in the browser; printing, copying and changes allowed or blocked
- [Unlock PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/unlock-pdf): removes a known password, or printing and copying restrictions (no password guessing)
- [PDF to Word](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-word): editable .docx with paragraphs, headings, lists and pictures; layout approximate
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-excel): one sheet per page, text columns into cells, numbers as numbers
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-powerpoint): one slide per page as a picture that looks exactly like the PDF, or editable text boxes and pictures (beta)
- [Word to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-to-pdf): .docx, .dotx, .docm and .odt as PDF pages laid out like the Word viewer, text searchable
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/excel-to-pdf): all visible sheets or one chosen by name, fitted to A4 or Letter with colours, borders and merges, text searchable
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pptx-to-pdf): one page per slide as the PowerPoint viewer shows it, text searchable
- [CSV to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/csv-to-pdf): a CSV table fitted to A4 or Letter, header row in bold, text searchable
- [Markdown to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/markdown-to-pdf), [Text to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/text-to-pdf) and [HTML to PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/html-to-pdf): typed, pasted or chosen text laid out on pages, text searchable; HTML is pasted, never fetched from an address
- [OCR PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/ocr-pdf): reads scanned pages (English, Arabic) on the device and adds an invisible text layer; pages unchanged
- [Translate PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/translate-pdf): English to Arabic or Arabic to English with on-device translation models, saved as an editable Word document
- [Image viewer](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/image-viewer): JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, HEIC, TIFF and SVG with zoom and the camera, date and GPS details
- [Compress image](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/compress-image): JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF with a quality slider, before/after comparison and size saved
- [Resize image](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/resize-image): pixels, percent, or Instagram, WhatsApp and passport photo sizes
- [Crop image](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/crop-image): free, square, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, passport or a transparent circle
- [Rotate image](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/rotate-image): 90 degrees left or right, 180 degrees, flip horizontally or vertically
- [Watermark image](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/watermark-image): text or logo, size, opacity, angle, nine positions or tiled
- [Remove image metadata](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-image-metadata): shows the GPS location, camera and date, then saves a clean copy (JPG, PNG and WebP pixels unchanged)
- [Photo editor](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/photo-editor): brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, seven filters and text, with undo
- [Image converter](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/convert-image): to JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF from any picture format, plus [HEIC to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/heic-to-jpg), [WebP to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/webp-to-jpg), [PNG to JPG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/png-to-jpg), [JPG to PNG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/jpg-to-png), [SVG to PNG](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/svg-to-png) and [Image to WebP](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/image-to-webp)
- [Meme generator](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/meme-generator): top and bottom captions in outlined letters, Arabic written right to left
- [Blur faces](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/blur-face): faces found on the device, blurred or pixelated; areas can be added or skipped by hand
- [Remove background](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-background): cut out a person or an object on the device, transparent PNG or white
- [Upscale image (beta)](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/upscale-image): 2× or 4× with an on-device AI model, up to 1,024 px input
- [Image to text](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/image-to-text): the text of photos, scans and screenshots (English, Arabic), read on the device; copy or download as .txt or .md
- [All tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/all-tools), grouped as [PDF tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-tools), [Image tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/image-tools), [Data tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/data-tools) and [Office tools](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/office-tools)

- [Why can't I edit the text in a PDF?](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/cant-edit-text-in-pdf): how a PDF stores text, what an editor can and can't change, and when to convert to Word instead

- [A jsonformatter.org and Code Beautify alternative](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/jsonformatter-alternative): what those sites say about saving, sharing and loading JSON (from their own pages, dated), and where they do more
- [How to give ChatGPT a PDF without losing the tables](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/pdf-to-ai-chat-with-tables): Why tables break when you copy a PDF into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, how Markdown keeps rows and columns, and how to convert in your browser with no upload.
- [How many tokens is my PDF?](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/how-many-tokens-is-my-pdf): What a token is, why Arabic, tables and the AI model change the count, why pages are a poor guide, and how to count a PDF's tokens in your browser, no upload.
- [How to give a Word document to an AI chat and keep its structure](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/word-document-to-ai-chat): Give a Word .docx file to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini with its headings, lists and links kept as Markdown, plus a step for tables. In your browser, no upload.
- [How to give a PowerPoint presentation to an AI chat](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/powerpoint-to-ai-chat): Give a PowerPoint deck to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini as a text outline with slide titles, bullet points and speaker notes, made in your browser with no upload.
- [How do I give an AI chat a spreadsheet it can read?](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/spreadsheet-to-ai-chat): How to give ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini a spreadsheet it can read: Markdown table or CSV, one sheet at a time, size in tokens, formulas, and hiding personal data.
- [How to make a Markdown table from a CSV file](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/make-markdown-table-from-csv): Turn a CSV into a Markdown table for a README, docs or AI chat: header and separator lines, column alignment, pipes and line breaks in cells, and wide tables.
- [What is the TOON format, and when does it save tokens?](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/what-is-toon-format): TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) explained: what it looks like next to JSON, how to read it, and measured token counts for uniform lists and nested data.
- [How to merge PDF files on any device](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/how-to-merge-pdf-files): Merge PDF files on any device: Preview on a Mac, Files or Shortcuts on iPhone, the browser on Windows and Android, plus page order, photos and file size.
- [How to split a PDF or save only some pages](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/how-to-split-a-pdf): Split a PDF into separate files by page ranges, every few pages or one per page, or save only the pages you need, in the browser or with Preview and Edge.
- [How to turn phone photos into one PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/photos-to-one-pdf): Turn phone photos into one PDF: pick JPG, HEIC or PNG pictures, set their order, page size and margins, straighten document photos and keep the file small.
- [How to password-protect a PDF](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/password-protect-pdf-free): Password-protect a PDF for free: the password to open versus print and copy restrictions, what a password stops, how to send it, and how to remove it later.
- [How to make a scanned PDF searchable](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/make-scanned-pdf-searchable): Make a scanned PDF searchable: what OCR does, English and Arabic, why it need not upload your file, how accurate it is, and how to get the text into Word.
- [How to reduce a photo's file size for email or a form](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/reduce-photo-file-size): Get a photo under 1 MB or any upload limit: resize first, pick the right quality and format, then check the result. Done in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [How to open iPhone HEIC photos on Windows](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/open-heic-on-windows): Why Windows won't open iPhone HEIC photos, how to view or convert them to JPG in your browser with nothing to install, and how to make the iPhone shoot JPG.
- [How to remove the location from a photo](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-location-from-photo): What GPS, camera and date details a phone photo carries, how to check them, how to remove them without losing quality, and phone settings that leave them out.
- [How to remove a photo's background without uploading it](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/remove-background-without-upload): Cut a person or object out of a photo with an on-device AI model in your browser: transparent PNG or white, what works well, and options already on your phone.
- [How to convert an Excel sheet to JSON for an API](https://www.openanydoc.com/en/convert-excel-to-json-for-api): Turn an Excel sheet into JSON an API or app can use: header row to keys, numbers vs text, leading zeros, ISO dates, empty cells as null, and picking the sheet.

## Tested limits

Measured on OpenAnyDoc's own pages (checked 20 November 2026); results depend on the device.

- CSV: a 120,000-row file opens in under a second, because only the rows on screen are drawn. There is no row limit of its own (Excel stops at 1,048,576 rows per sheet).
- Excel: a sheet with 100,000 rows opens in about two seconds. Cell styles are read for files up to 8 MB; larger workbooks open as values and formulas.
- Text: a 46 MB text file shows its first lines in under half a second; above 2 million characters it opens in a fast read view.
- JSON: files up to 10 MB open; larger files are refused before they are read.
- CSV, Excel and text files over 50 MB show a warning first and still open if the device has the memory.
- Upscale image: pictures up to 1,024 pixels on the long side for 2×, 512 for 4×.
